name: Zentral Boost
description: Read browser RAM on demand and give memory back without closing anything. Standalone part of Zentral Extended.
externalPrefsReason: OW-112 reads the retired keep_pinned pref once, to carry an owner's existing 'on' choice over to unload_pinned and use it as a read-only fallback for one release. W5 reads the retired Widgets Boost toggle once to migrate a saved value to Boost's widget_enabled preference; it is never cleared or exposed as a second setting.
fullPackOnlyReason: The panel layer (`window.Zentral.Panels`) only exists in the full pack. Every use is guarded: a standalone Boost has no Essential panels to put to sleep, so a deep pass there unloads tabs only.
